evidence: No dedicated secret-scanning tool (e.g., Gitleaks, TruffleHog, detect-secrets, GitGuardian) is invoked via `uses:` or `run:` in any of the provided workflow files.
No SAST scanner appropriate for the application language (e.g., CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube, Bandit) is invoked in any of the provided workflow files.
No dependency vulnerability scanning tool (e.g., Trivy, Grype, npm audit, pip-audit, govulncheck, cargo-audit, Snyk, or OWASP Dependency-Check) is invoked in any of the provided workflow files.
No SBOM generation tool (e.g., Syft, cdxgen) is invoked to generate a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM covering source-level dependencies in any of the provided workflow files.
No cryptographic signing of the source-level SBOM (e.g., via `cosign sign` or in-toto attestation) is performed in any of the provided workflow files.
No tool (e.g., Syft targeting the built image/artifact) is invoked to generate a separate SBOM for the build artifact in any of the provided workflow files.
No cryptographic signing of the build artifact SBOM (e.g., `cosign attach-sbom` combined with `cosign sign`) is performed in any of the provided workflow files.

No container-aware scanner (e.g., Trivy, Grype, Clair) or appropriate dependency/artifact scanner is invoked to scan the final build output before publishing or deployment in any of the provided workflow files.
No cryptographic signing of the produced artifact (e.g., via Cosign/Sigstore, GPG, or npm provenance) is performed in any of the provided workflow files.
No signed build provenance metadata (e.g., SLSA provenance via `actions/attest-build-provenance`, in-toto attestations, or `cosign attest`) is generated in any of the provided workflow files.
No step is present to scan the built artifact or container image itself for accidentally embedded secrets in any of the provided workflow files.

No fuzzing tool (e.g., libFuzzer, AFL++, go-fuzz, jsfuzz, or OSS-Fuzz/ClusterFuzzLite integration) is invoked in any of the provided workflow files, and no `fuzz/` or `test/fuzzers/` directory is referenced.
No step is present to verify the artifact's signature (e.g., `cosign verify`) against a trusted public key before deploying to any live environment in any of the provided workflow files.

No step is present to verify the artifact's build provenance attestation matches the expected source repository and commit before deploying to any live environment in any of the provided workflow files.
